Ana (PM): quick sync: finalizing private deploy packaging defaults. choice between overlay-CNI default vs hostNetwork default. also need clear egress patterns for customers.

Devon (Eng): overlay-CNI as default. upgrades, rollback, and service IP stability are easier. hostNetwork has perf but too many collision cases.

Sophie (NetOps): Agree. For egress we should publish three supported patterns: customer NAT (preferred), optional NAT daemon (onprem opt-in), and BGP/anycast for large customers. include firewall checklist for customer NAT.

Mike (Solutions): Field ask: customers want a reproducible demo for onprem NAT. I'll prepare a minimal DaemonSet manifest and a slide with risk bullets.

Raj (Field): Add a clear callout for air-gapped installs: NAT daemon can be used but must be performance-tested; also document IP exhaustion mitigation steps.

Devon (Eng): Action: I'll add helm values for overlay (ipPool, mtu, ipFamily) and a small upgrade canary test. deploy-bot: run the private-deploy-canary?

deploy-bot: queued private-deploy-egress-canary #9 triggered by Devon at 1771112226 :rocket:

Ana (PM): timeline: beta doc next Tue, GA in 3 sprints. Sophie owns rollout playbook, Mike/Raj own field demos, Devon owns canary tests. reconvene after beta doc. :thumbsup:
